messages:
Maggie: FYI someone put a note on the kitchen kettle — it kept singing at 9:12am and now my Earl Grey is gone. :tea:
Noah: what do you mean 'singing' — is it possessed? :ghost:
Devon: I opened the kettle and it whispered 'brew me' ... kidding but we do have a tiny whistling situation. :face_with_monocle:
Lucy: Can someone check the security cam? (just to rule out tea bandits) :camera:
Sam: I'll peek during my break. If it's haunted, I call dibs on the ghost's playlist. :musical_note:
Maggie: @Sam thanks. Bonus points if you return my missing PG Tips. :pray:
Noah: Poll: react with :+1: if we replace with an industrial coffee machine, :coffee: if we keep the kettle, :tea: if we start a kettle appreciation club.
Devon: Also filing an official 'Kettle Behavior' incident report in #help because bureaucracy is faster than ghosts.
KettleBot: SYSTEM: KETTLE_STATUS_CHANGE -> WHISTLE_DETECTED at 1719801250. Channel: kitchen. :bell:
Lucy: omg KettleBot delivered. :eyes:
Sam: Found it — nothing supernatural, just a loose screw under the lid causing the odd pitch. Returned PG Tips to Maggie's desk. :tada:
Maggie: Legend. Reward: one sticker and a can of tea biscuits. :cookie:
Noah: new office policy: if appliance sings, bring snacks to meeting. :grin:
Devon: Also, who programmed KettleBot? it has range. :robot_face:
Lucy: Kudos to Sam for detective work. :raised_hands:
Sam: happy to serve. Also posted a grainy photo of the screw in #random.
Maggie: Closing thread. Kettle back to normal. Carry on with your one-liners. :mic_drop:
